Setting include_document_structure populates the structured document tree on the result

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<article><h1>Heading</h1><p>Paragraph body.</p></article>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(include_document_structure: true))
puts result.content.inspect
```
